bibl.title: A novel class of inferior colliculus principal neurons labeled in vasoactive intestinal peptide-Cre mice

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: whether a molecular marker can carve a class out of a structure whose neurons HAVE PROVEN DIFFICULT TO DELINEATE INTO DISTINCT CLASSES
span.quote: This is because probing neural circuits requires the ability to identify and manipulate specific classes of neurons, but IC neurons have proven difficult to delineate into distinct classes.

span.label: how to identify neuron classes where every existing criterion has failed - PROBING NEURAL CIRCUITS REQUIRES THE ABILITY TO IDENTIFY AND MANIPULATE SPECIFIC CLASSES OF NEURONS, BUT IC NEURONS HAVE PROVEN DIFFICULT TO DELINEATE INTO DISTINCT CLASSES
span.quote: This is because probing neural circuits requires the ability to identify and manipulate specific classes of neurons, but IC neurons have proven difficult to delineate into distinct classes.

span.label: BY COMBINING MOLECULAR, MORPHOLOGICAL, AND PHYSIOLOGICAL ANALYSES, WE IDENTIFY VASOACTIVE INTESTINAL PEPTIDE (VIP) NEURONS AS A NOVEL CLASS OF IC PRINCIPAL NEURONS - GLUTAMATERGIC STELLATE CELLS WITH SUSTAINED FIRING PATTERNS
span.quote: In many brain regions, a multidimensional analysis that includes molecular markers has proven key to identifying neuron classes ( Ascoli et al., 2008 ; Tremblay et al., 2016 ; Zeng and Sanes, 2017 ). Here, by combining molecular, morphological, and physiological analyses, we identify vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP) neurons as a novel class of IC principal neurons.

span.label: existence
span.quote: Using a multifaceted approach in mice, we have identified vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP) neurons as a novel class of IC principal neurons.

span.label: inferior colliculus neuron classes
span.quote: Although the IC plays important roles in speech processing, sound localization, and other auditory computations, the organization of the IC microcircuitry remains largely unknown.

span.label: electrophysiology
span.quote: Next, we investigated the firing pattern and intrinsic physiology of VIP neurons by targeting whole cell patch clamp recordings to tdTomato + neurons in brain slices from VIP-IRES-Cre x Ai14 mice.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: DCN afferents excite local IC GABAergic neurons, which then inhibit VIP neurons disynaptically; because the inhibition arrives just after the excitation it truncates the EPSP and narrows the window over which ascending input can summate
span.quote: Because DCN to IC projections are glutamatergic ( Ito and Oliver, 2010 ; Oliver, 1984 ), and the periolivary nuclei and nuclei of the lateral lemniscus, the sources of ascending GABAergic input to the IC ( González-Hernández et al., 1996 ), were not present in the brain slice, this inhibition must be due to DCN afferents activating a local feedforward inhibitory circuit within the IC.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: commissural synapses are placed on distal dendrites or spines, where AMPA-receptor current depolarizes the local membrane enough to expel the Mg2+ block, so NMDA receptors open even while the soma sits at rest
span.quote: The activation of NMDA receptors in our recordings may indicate that excitatory commissural synapses tend to be located on the distal dendrites or dendritic spines of VIP neurons, where the local membrane potential might be sufficiently depolarized by activation of AMPA receptors to remove Mg 2+ block of NMDA receptors.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: feedforward inhibition shortens EPSP halfwidth and thereby sets the time window for temporal summation of synaptic input onto VIP neurons
span.quote: Feedforward inhibition can dramatically reduce EPSP halfwidth, suggesting that local feedforward inhibition regulates the temporal summation of synaptic inputs.

span.label: the classification argument the paper rests on: IT HAS LONG BEEN ARGUED THAT THE CLASSIFICATION OF NEURONS REQUIRES A MULTIFACETED ANALYSIS OF MORPHOLOGICAL AND PHYSIOLOGICAL FEATURES - MORE RECENT EFFORTS HAVE EMPHASIZED THE IMPORTANCE OF COMBINING THESE FEATURES WITH MOLECULAR MARKERS
span.quote: It has long been argued that the classification of neurons requires a multifaceted analysis of morphological and physiological features ( Tyner, 1975 ). More recent efforts have emphasized the importance of combining these features with molecular markers ( Ascoli et al., 2008 ; Tremblay et al., 2016 ; Zeng and Sanes, 2017 ). This combination has proven to be particularly effective for unambiguously classifying neuron types.

span.label: and the reason no single feature works here, stated of their own class: VIP NEURONS ARE NOT THE ONLY STELLATE NEURONS IN THE IC, NOR ARE THEY THE ONLY NEURONS WITH SUSTAINED FIRING PATTERNS OR DENDRITIC SPINES - THESE RESULTS PROVIDE INSIGHT TO WHY IT HAS BEEN DIFFICULT TO CLASSIFY NEURON TYPES IN THE IC
span.quote: rons are not the only stellate neurons in the IC, nor are they the only neurons with sustained firing patterns or dendritic spines. These results provide insight to why it has been difficult to classify neuron types in the IC. We propose that a multidimensional approach incorporating molecular markers will be essential to identifying the remaining neuron classes in the IC.

span.label: why the circuit question could not be answered before: AXONS FROM MULTIPLE SOURCES OVERLAP IN THE IC, MAKING IT DIFFICULT TO USE ELECTRICAL STIMULATION TO SELECTIVELY ACTIVATE AXONS FROM SPECIFIC PRESYNAPTIC SOURCES - and ELECTRICAL STIMULATION OF COMMISSURAL PROJECTIONS CANNOT DIFFERENTIATE BETWEEN AXONS ORIGINATING IN THE IPSILATERAL AND CONTRALATERAL IC
span.quote: This is largely because axons from multiple sources overlap in the IC, making it difficult to use electrical stimulation to selectively activate axons from specific presynaptic sources. In addition, electrical stimulation of commissural projections cannot differentiate between axons originating in the ipsilateral and contralateral IC.

span.label: Possible morphological differences between VIP neurons in different IC subdivisions were not analysed in detail.
span.note: what this limits: any subdivision-specific morphological claim: THERE WERE NO OBVIOUS DIFFERENCES ... BUT THIS QUESTION WARRANTS MORE DETAILED ANALYSIS IN A FUTURE STUDY
span.quote: There were no obvious differences between the morphology of VIP neurons in the ICc versus the ICd or IClc, but this question warrants more detailed analysis in a future study.

span.label: Antidromic spikes may have contaminated the electrically evoked postsynaptic potential measurements.
span.note: what this limits: the postsynaptic potential measurements: WE CANNOT EXCLUDE THAT ANTIDROMIC SPIKES MAY HAVE INFLUENCED PSP ANALYSIS
span.quote: Also, we cannot exclude that antidromic spikes may have influenced PSP analysis.

span.label: Electrical stimulation recordings were biased toward more rostral VIP neurons, unlike the optogenetic recordings.
span.note: what this limits: the electrical-stimulation results specifically: THESE RECORDINGS HAD TO BE BIASED TO VIP NEURONS IN MORE ROSTRAL PARTS OF THE IC ... A BIAS THAT WAS NOT PRESENT IN THE CRACM RECORDINGS
span.quote: It should be noted that to position the stimulus electrode in the IC commissure contralateral to the recording site, these recordings had to be biased to VIP neurons in more rostral parts of the IC where the commissure was clearly visible, a bias that was not present in the CRACM recordings.

span.label: the class is statistically separable and internally heterogeneous at once - ALTHOUGH STATISTICALLY DIFFERENT FROM THE GENERAL NEURONAL POPULATION IN THE IC AND SHOWING A TIGHTLY CLUSTERED SFA RATIO, THE INTRINSIC PHYSIOLOGY OF VIP NEURONS STILL SHOWED SOME LEVEL OF VARIABILITY
span.note: what this limits: treating membership of this class as a prediction about any individual cell's intrinsic properties
span.quote: Although statistically different from the general neuronal population in the IC and showing a tightly clustered SFA ratio, the intrinsic physiology of VIP neurons still showed some level of variability.

span.label: the defining firing pattern is not universal within the class - 90.3% (214 OF 237) OF PATCHED VIP NEURONS EXHIBITED A SUSTAINED FIRING PATTERN, 8.4% (20 OF 237) SHOWED AN ADAPTING FIRING PATTERN, AND 1.3% (3 OF 237) OF VIP NEURONS HAD A TRANSIENT FIRING PATTERN
span.note: what this limits: the defining property of the proposed class: 90.3% (214 OF 237) OF PATCHED VIP NEURONS EXHIBITED A SUSTAINED FIRING PATTERN, 8.4% ... AN ADAPTING FIRING PATTERN ... AND 1.3% ... TRANSIENT
span.quote: 90.3% (214 of 237) of patched VIP neurons exhibited a sustained firing pattern, 8.4% (20 of 237) showed an adapting firing pattern (SFA ratio >= 2), and 1.3% (3 of 237) of VIP neurons had a transient firing pattern (firing stopped before the end of the current step)

span.label: and no single feature identifies the class - DENDRITIC SPINES CAN BE PRESENT ON A VARIETY OF CELL TYPES, INCLUDING STELLATE AND DISC-SHAPED CELLS
span.note: what this limits: using spininess, stellate morphology or sustained firing on its own to identify a VIP neuron
span.quote: Nonetheless, dendritic spines can be present on a variety of cell types, including stellate and disc-shaped cells

span.label: three subdivisions were pooled on the strength of a null - RECORDINGS MADE FROM THE ICc, ICd, AND IClc WERE LUMPED TOGETHER FOR THIS EXPERIMENT BECAUSE THERE WERE NO CLEAR DIFFERENCES IN VIP NEURON PHYSIOLOGY ACROSS THESE SUBDIVISIONS OF THE IC
span.note: what this limits: reading any pooled physiological value as specific to one subdivision
span.quote: Recordings made from the ICc, ICd, and IClc were lumped together for this experiment because there were no clear differences in VIP neuron physiology across these subdivisions of the IC.

span.label: OLIVER AND COLLEAGUES DISTINGUISHED DISC-SHAPED FROM STELLATE NEURONS BY CALCULATING THE LENGTH TO WIDTH RATIO OF THE DENDRITIC ARBOR: NEURONS WITH A RATIO <3 WERE STELLATE AND THOSE WITH A RATIO >= 3 WERE DISC-SHAPED
span.note: what this limits: treating `stellate` as a natural kind rather than as one side of a ratio of 3
span.quote: Oliver and colleagues distinguished disc-shaped from stellate neurons by calculating the length to width ratio of the dendritic arbor: neurons with a ratio <3 were stellate and those with a ratio >= 3 were disc-shaped ( Oliver et al., 1991 ). Applying this classification to our sample, 93% of VIP neurons in the ICc (39 of 42 neurons) had a length to width ratio <3, therefore being classified as stellate ( Figure 5H ). Only three VIP neurons from the ICc had a length to width ratio >3.

span.label: the requirement that A CLASSIFICATION OF NEURONS REQUIRES A MULTIFACETED ANALYSIS OF MORPHOLOGICAL AND PHYSIOLOGICAL FEATURES
span.quote: It has long been argued that the classification of neurons requires a multifaceted analysis of morphological and physiological features ( Tyner, 1975 ). More recent efforts have emphasized the importance of combining these features with molecular markers ( Ascoli et al., 2008 ; Tremblay et al., 2016 ; Zeng and Sanes, 2017 ). This combination has proven to be particularly effective for unambiguously classifying neuron types.

span.label: the marker-plus-morphology-plus-physiology scheme, which THERE has ENABLED INVESTIGATIONS INTO HOW SPECIFIC CLASSES OF INTERNEURONS SHAPE CIRCUIT COMPUTATIONS, SENSORY PROCESSING, AND ANIMAL BEHAVIOR
span.quote: In the cerebral cortex, a multifaceted classification scheme including molecular markers has enabled investigations into how specific classes of interneurons shape circuit computations, sensory processing, and animal behavior ( Cichon et al., 2017 ; Kato et al., 2017 ; Kato et al., 2015 ; Kuchibhotla et al., 2017 ; Lee et al., 2013 ; Milstein et al., 2015 ; Pfeffer et al., 2013 ; Pi et al., 2013 ). Similar approaches have succeeded in the amygdala, hypothalamus, basal ganglia, and other brain regions where it was previously difficult to identify neuron types

span.label: a randomly patched, non-targeted population from a wild-type line, recorded the same way
span.quote: To compare the physiology of VIP neurons to that of the general population of neurons in the IC, we patched neurons in IC slices of C57BL/6J mice in a random, non-targeted approach as a control. Neurons patched with the non-targeted (NT) approach showed a higher diversity in firing patterns, with a higher proportion of transient neurons (21.8%, 12 out of 55) and adapting neurons (16.4%, 9 out of 55) when compared to VIP neurons. Sustained firing neurons were the most prevalent group in NT recordings (58.2%, 32 out of 55).

span.label: the spine count compared against the same non-targeted sample
span.quote: y all (81/86 = 94.2%) VIP neurons had spiny dendrites ( Figure 5A,B insets). This contrasts sharply with the 28% (12 of 43 neurons) of neurons that had spiny dendrites in non-targeted recordings from C57BL/6J mice ( Figure 5C ), suggesting that VIP neurons represent a subset of IC cells.

span.label: the morphology classified by a published quantitative rule rather than by eye
span.quote: Oliver and colleagues distinguished disc-shaped from stellate neurons by calculating the length to width ratio of the dendritic arbor: neurons with a ratio <3 were stellate and those with a ratio >= 3 were disc-shaped ( Oliver et al., 1991 ). Applying this classification to our sample, 93% of VIP neurons in the ICc (39 of 42 neurons) had a length to width ratio <3, therefore being classified as stellate ( Figure 5H ). Only three VIP neurons from the ICc had a length to width ratio >3.

span.label: the pooling across subdivisions tested before it was done
span.quote: Recordings made from the ICc, ICd, and IClc were lumped together for this experiment because there were no clear differences in VIP neuron physiology across these subdivisions of the IC.

span.label: the residual variability followed up rather than left as noise
span.quote: In the lower auditory brainstem, it has been found that the intrinsic physiology of some neurons varies along the tonotopic axis ( Baumann et al., 2013 ; Hassfurth et al., 2009 ). We therefore hypothesized that the intrinsic physiology of VIP neurons in the ICc varied along the tonotopic axis of the ICc.

span.label: EVERY EXISTING CRITERION HAD FAILED, AND THE PAPER LISTS THEM. Morphology: BOTH DISC-SHAPED AND STELLATE CELLS CAN BE GLUTAMATERGIC OR GABAERGIC, AN INDICATION THAT EACH OF THESE MORPHOLOGICAL GROUPS CONSISTS OF AT LEAST TWO NEURON TYPES
span.quote: Both disc-shaped and stellate cells can be glutamatergic or GABAergic, an indication that each of these morphological groups consists of at least two neuron types

span.label: Tone responses: A COMPREHENSIVE STUDY SHOWED THAT THESE RESPONSES FORM A CONTINUUM AND CANNOT BE USED ON THEIR OWN TO DEFINE FUNCTIONALLY SIGNIFICANT GROUPS OF NEURONS. A category defeated by a measured continuum, not by disagreement
span.quote: Defining IC neuron types based on physiology has also proven difficult. IC neurons exhibit diverse responses to tones, but a comprehensive study showed that these responses form a continuum and cannot be used on their own to define functionally significant groups of neurons

span.label: AND THE CRITERIA DO NOT PREDICT EACH OTHER: IC NEURONS EXHIBIT DIVERSE FIRING PATTERNS, BUT THESE FIRING PATTERNS DO NOT CORRELATE WITH NEURONAL MORPHOLOGY OR NEUROTRANSMITTER PHENOTYPE. Three ways of sorting the same cells, mutually uninformative - the strongest version in the corpus of `partially overlapping categories`
span.quote: recordings have shown that IC neurons exhibit diverse firing patterns, but these firing patterns do not correlate with neuronal morphology or neurotransmitter phenotype

span.label: and the one type everyone agrees on has no marker: ‘LARGE GABAERGIC’ NEURONS ARE THE ONE CONSISTENTLY IDENTIFIED NEURON TYPE IN THE IC - HOWEVER, THERE ARE CURRENTLY NO KNOWN MOLECULAR MARKERS SPECIFIC FOR LARGE GABAERGIC NEURONS
span.quote: Among these, ‘large GABAergic’ neurons are the one consistently identified neuron type in the IC ( Geis and Borst, 2013 ; Ito et al., 2015 ; Ito et al., 2009 ; Ito and Oliver, 2012 ). However, there are currently no known molecular markers specific for large GABAergic neurons

span.label: THE CLASS EXISTS ONLY AS A CONJUNCTION, AND THE PAPER SAYS SO OF ITS OWN FINDING: VIP NEURONS ARE NOT THE ONLY STELLATE NEURONS IN THE IC, NOR ARE THEY THE ONLY NEURONS WITH SUSTAINED FIRING PATTERNS OR DENDRITIC SPINES - THESE RESULTS PROVIDE INSIGHT TO WHY IT HAS BEEN DIFFICULT TO CLASSIFY NEURON TYPES IN THE IC
span.quote: rons are not the only stellate neurons in the IC, nor are they the only neurons with sustained firing patterns or dendritic spines. These results provide insight to why it has been difficult to classify neuron types in the IC. We propose that a multidimensional approach incorporating molecular markers will be essential to identifying the remaining neuron classes in the IC.

span.label: THE ARGUMENT IS EXPLICITLY TAXONOMIC AND IT IS OLD: IT HAS LONG BEEN ARGUED THAT THE CLASSIFICATION OF NEURONS REQUIRES A MULTIFACETED ANALYSIS OF MORPHOLOGICAL AND PHYSIOLOGICAL FEATURES - MORE RECENT EFFORTS HAVE EMPHASIZED THE IMPORTANCE OF COMBINING THESE FEATURES WITH MOLECULAR MARKERS
span.quote: It has long been argued that the classification of neurons requires a multifaceted analysis of morphological and physiological features ( Tyner, 1975 ). More recent efforts have emphasized the importance of combining these features with molecular markers ( Ascoli et al., 2008 ; Tremblay et al., 2016 ; Zeng and Sanes, 2017 ). This combination has proven to be particularly effective for unambiguously classifying neuron types.

span.label: and it is imported from the structure where it worked: IN THE CEREBRAL CORTEX, A MULTIFACETED CLASSIFICATION SCHEME INCLUDING MOLECULAR MARKERS HAS ENABLED INVESTIGATIONS INTO HOW SPECIFIC CLASSES OF INTERNEURONS SHAPE CIRCUIT COMPUTATIONS - SIMILAR APPROACHES HAVE SUCCEEDED IN THE AMYGDALA, HYPOTHALAMUS, BASAL GANGLIA, AND OTHER BRAIN REGIONS WHERE IT WAS PREVIOUSLY DIFFICULT TO IDENTIFY NEURON TYPES
span.quote: In the cerebral cortex, a multifaceted classification scheme including molecular markers has enabled investigations into how specific classes of interneurons shape circuit computations, sensory processing, and animal behavior ( Cichon et al., 2017 ; Kato et al., 2017 ; Kato et al., 2015 ; Kuchibhotla et al., 2017 ; Lee et al., 2013 ; Milstein et al., 2015 ; Pfeffer et al., 2013 ; Pi et al., 2013 ). Similar approaches have succeeded in the amygdala, hypothalamus, basal ganglia, and other brain regions where it was previously difficult to identify neuron types

span.label: THE SAME MARKER, THE OPPOSITE KIND OF CELL: here VIP labels GLUTAMATERGIC STELLATE CELLS WITH SUSTAINED FIRING PATTERNS whose EXTENSIVE AXONS PROJECT TO LONG-RANGE TARGETS - excitatory projection neurons. In cortex the same Cre line labels GABAergic interneurons, and the paper cites that literature on the same page
span.quote: Located in the midbrain, the inferior colliculus (IC) is the hub of the central auditory system. Although the IC plays important roles in speech processing, sound localization, and other auditory computations, the organization of the IC microcircuitry remains largely unknown. Using a multifaceted approach in mice, we have identified vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP) neurons as a novel class of IC principal neurons. VIP neurons are glutamatergic stellate cells with sustained firing patterns. Their extensive axons project to long-range targets including the auditory thalamus, auditory brainstem, superior colliculus, and periaqueductal gray. Using optogenetic circuit mapping, we found that VIP neurons integrate input from the contralateral IC and the dorsal cochlear nucleus. The dorsal cochlear nucleus also drove feedforward inhibition to VIP neurons, indicating that inhibitory circuits within the IC shape the temporal integration of ascending inputs. Thus, VIP neurons are well-positioned to influence auditory computations in a number of brain regions.

span.label: A CLASSIFICATION THRESHOLD IMPORTED FROM 1991 AND APPLIED AS A DEFINITION: NEURONS WITH A RATIO <3 WERE STELLATE AND THOSE WITH A RATIO >= 3 WERE DISC-SHAPED - APPLYING THIS CLASSIFICATION TO OUR SAMPLE, 93% OF VIP NEURONS IN THE ICc HAD A LENGTH TO WIDTH RATIO <3
span.quote: Oliver and colleagues distinguished disc-shaped from stellate neurons by calculating the length to width ratio of the dendritic arbor: neurons with a ratio <3 were stellate and those with a ratio >= 3 were disc-shaped ( Oliver et al., 1991 ). Applying this classification to our sample, 93% of VIP neurons in the ICc (39 of 42 neurons) had a length to width ratio <3, therefore being classified as stellate ( Figure 5H ). Only three VIP neurons from the ICc had a length to width ratio >3.

span.label: A RANDOM COMPARISON POPULATION, WHICH IS WHAT MAKES THE CLASS A CLAIM: WE PATCHED NEURONS IN IC SLICES OF C57BL/6J MICE IN A RANDOM, NON-TARGETED APPROACH AS A CONTROL - NEURONS PATCHED WITH THE NON-TARGETED (NT) APPROACH SHOWED A HIGHER DIVERSITY IN FIRING PATTERNS
span.quote: To compare the physiology of VIP neurons to that of the general population of neurons in the IC, we patched neurons in IC slices of C57BL/6J mice in a random, non-targeted approach as a control. Neurons patched with the non-targeted (NT) approach showed a higher diversity in firing patterns, with a higher proportion of transient neurons (21.8%, 12 out of 55) and adapting neurons (16.4%, 9 out of 55) when compared to VIP neurons. Sustained firing neurons were the most prevalent group in NT recordings (58.2%, 32 out of 55).

span.label: and a NEGATIVE that helps define the class: 3.6% (2 OF 55) OF RANDOMLY PATCHED IC NEURONS FIRED ONLY ONE SPIKE AT THE ONSET OF THE DEPOLARIZING CURRENT STEP - THIS FIRING PATTERN WAS NEVER OBSERVED IN VIP NEURONS
span.quote: Additionally, 3.6% (2 of 55) of randomly patched IC neurons fired only one spike at the onset of the depolarizing current step. This firing pattern was never observed in VIP neurons.

span.label: THE CLASS IS SEPARABLE AND INTERNALLY VARIABLE AT THE SAME TIME: ALTHOUGH STATISTICALLY DIFFERENT FROM THE GENERAL NEURONAL POPULATION IN THE IC AND SHOWING A TIGHTLY CLUSTERED SFA RATIO, THE INTRINSIC PHYSIOLOGY OF VIP NEURONS STILL SHOWED SOME LEVEL OF VARIABILITY
span.quote: Although statistically different from the general neuronal population in the IC and showing a tightly clustered SFA ratio, the intrinsic physiology of VIP neurons still showed some level of variability.

span.label: and the defining property is not universal: 90.3% OF PATCHED VIP NEURONS EXHIBITED A SUSTAINED FIRING PATTERN, 8.4% SHOWED AN ADAPTING FIRING PATTERN, AND 1.3% HAD A TRANSIENT FIRING PATTERN - a class defined by a property one in ten of its members lacks
span.quote: 90.3% (214 of 237) of patched VIP neurons exhibited a sustained firing pattern, 8.4% (20 of 237) showed an adapting firing pattern (SFA ratio >= 2), and 1.3% (3 of 237) of VIP neurons had a transient firing pattern (firing stopped before the end of the current step)

span.label: A LUMPING DECISION JUSTIFIED BY A NULL: RECORDINGS MADE FROM THE ICc, ICd, AND IClc WERE LUMPED TOGETHER FOR THIS EXPERIMENT BECAUSE THERE WERE NO CLEAR DIFFERENCES IN VIP NEURON PHYSIOLOGY ACROSS THESE SUBDIVISIONS OF THE IC. The pooling is declared and its reason is an absence
span.quote: Recordings made from the ICc, ICd, and IClc were lumped together for this experiment because there were no clear differences in VIP neuron physiology across these subdivisions of the IC.

span.label: and the residual spread was followed rather than left as noise: WE THEREFORE HYPOTHESIZED THAT THE INTRINSIC PHYSIOLOGY OF VIP NEURONS IN THE ICc VARIED ALONG THE TONOTOPIC AXIS OF THE ICc
span.quote: In the lower auditory brainstem, it has been found that the intrinsic physiology of some neurons varies along the tonotopic axis ( Baumann et al., 2013 ; Hassfurth et al., 2009 ). We therefore hypothesized that the intrinsic physiology of VIP neurons in the ICc varied along the tonotopic axis of the ICc.

span.label: THE CLASS IS SMALL: VIP NEURONS REPRESENT 2.3% OF THE TOTAL POPULATION OF NEURONS IN THE MOUSE IC (208 OF 9304 NEURONS)
span.quote: Overall, a combined count of VIP neurons from the ICc and IC shell showed that VIP neurons represent 2.3 ± 0.3% of the total population of neurons in the mouse IC

span.label: WHY THE OLD METHOD COULD NOT ANSWER THE QUESTION: AXONS FROM MULTIPLE SOURCES OVERLAP IN THE IC, MAKING IT DIFFICULT TO USE ELECTRICAL STIMULATION TO SELECTIVELY ACTIVATE AXONS FROM SPECIFIC PRESYNAPTIC SOURCES - and ELECTRICAL STIMULATION OF COMMISSURAL PROJECTIONS CANNOT DIFFERENTIATE BETWEEN AXONS ORIGINATING IN THE IPSILATERAL AND CONTRALATERAL IC
span.quote: This is largely because axons from multiple sources overlap in the IC, making it difficult to use electrical stimulation to selectively activate axons from specific presynaptic sources. In addition, electrical stimulation of commissural projections cannot differentiate between axons originating in the ipsilateral and contralateral IC.

span.label: and the spininess that helps mark the class is not exclusive to it: DENDRITIC SPINES CAN BE PRESENT ON A VARIETY OF CELL TYPES, INCLUDING STELLATE AND DISC-SHAPED CELLS
span.quote: Nonetheless, dendritic spines can be present on a variety of cell types, including stellate and disc-shaped cells
